metadata.description: Canvas LMS course tools for instructors and curriculum designers (Claude Code plugins): accessibility remediation, restyling, content generation, and course export/import.

plugins.name: courseforge
plugins.description: CourseForge: remediate (ADA/Ally, incl. PowerPoint), restyle, build, and move Canvas courses — generate pages/syllabi/assignments/quizzes/exams, export/import/clone (.imscc + Canvas-to-Canvas copy), weekly modules, weighted grading, nav trim, auto due dates, optional Notion import. Content-first; includes one opt-in best-effort blind-grading flow that keeps identities local.

plugins.name: canvas-pii-guard
plugins.description: Local PII-prevention hooks: blocks Canvas student-data API calls and local-cache reads before they run, so student data is never fetched or transmitted. Install on instructor machines alongside courseforge.
